name: Freyalise
title: Guardian of Elvenkind
role: Ancient planeswalker and protector of Skyshroud
summary: A formidable guardian who ended Dominaria's Ice Age and died sealing the Skyshroud rift.
biography: Freyalise had wielded extraordinary power since the age of the Ice Age, when her magic helped end the long supernatural winter. She became particularly associated with elven communities and the defense of their forests.
After the Rathi Overlay transplanted Skyshroud into Keld, Freyalise continued to protect its inhabitants from threats even while the growing temporal rift weakened the plane.
Recognizing the threat to all of Dominaria, she sacrificed her life and power to heal the fracture above Skyshroud.

Freyalise's career spans two major phases of Dominarian history that should not be collapsed. In the Ice Age story, her intervention is tied to the World Spell and the end of a supernatural winter; in the Mending story, the challenge is a specific temporal rupture threatening the land and people under her protection.

For inhabitants of Skyshroud, she was not an abstract embodiment of planeswalker might. Her connection to elven communities involved long-standing expectations of defense and stewardship. The displacement of the forest during the Rathi Overlay sharpened the problem by placing familiar life within a transformed landscape.

Her final sacrifice illustrates how the old planeswalkers confronted limits even before the Multiverse changed around them. The repair of the rift was local and costly, not a simple spell that reversed every consequence of the invasion or the Ice Age. Her departure left survivors to live in the world she had helped preserve.

featuredCard.significance: A later planeswalker card representing the elven protector who sacrificed herself during the Mending.
